correctness.rationale: Direct Jacobian differentiation, Euler inclusion, three affine dual-number presentations and regular sequence of height three prove the full scheme. Gorenstein duality yields the canonical nilradical. Non-splitting follows from Picard injectivity and H0/H1 of O(-1); Euler sequence proves the one-dimensional extension group. Exact script checks local reductions and Hilbert coefficients, not substituted for infinite arguments.

value.rationale: The canonical rank-one nilradical and nontrivial extension classify a naturally arising singular scheme that local derivative vanishing cannot distinguish from a split thickening. It realizes the unique nonsplit abstract canonical double P2, gives intrinsic K3-type invariants and contrasts with scroll-supported K3 carpets.
